8 Ks. Scoreless. 101.5 mph velocity.

The Brewers just took first place in the NL Central.

Miz (14-5, 1.73 ERA, 222 K) is the best pitcher in baseball. September just proved it.

#Brewers #MLB

Tonight at Wrigley: 101.5 mph. Scoreless. 8 strikeouts.

The Cy Young race is over.

#Brewers #MisiorowskiCyYoung
